info.description: Site-wide settings such as analytics / tag IDs

siteName.description: Site name used as the browser-title suffix and og:site_name. Blank falls back to "The American Club Singapore".

defaultSeo.description: Site-wide fallback metadata (title, description, share image). Any page whose own SEO fields are blank inherits these.

googleTagId.description: Google Tag ID. Accepts a Google tag (G-, GT-, or AW-XXXXXXXX, loaded via gtag.js) or a Google Tag Manager container (GTM-XXXXXXX, loaded via gtm.js). The correct snippet is chosen automatically from the prefix. Leave blank to disable analytics.

loadMoreLabel.description: Button label for paginated lists (News, Gallery). Blank falls back to "Load More".

readMoreLabel.description: Link label on News article cards. Blank falls back to "Read More".

viewAlbumLabel.description: CTA label on Gallery album cards. Blank falls back to "View Album".
